chapter: Rockwell: Los Angeles club and sessions
title: Pay and set lengths
summary: Rockwell guesses sidemen earned about $26 a night and describes the length of sets and breaks.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Do you know how much the band was getting paid?

I'm not sure. It seemed to be that, uh... the Sidemen were getting $26, but that's just a guess. I know. It seemed like I saw that, but I... I could be... yeah, for night. Well, that would have been... Tuesday and Wednesday... Well, somewhat more than scale, I guess. Or would that have been scale? I think for an out-of-town band, it might have been scale. Yeah. I think George, uh... might have gotten more.
I think he probably might have gotten one and a half that or something. Hmm. I see.
They had a little place, uh... right behind the bandstand that would... they would go back, and... they would have their bottles, and they...
What about the sets? Was it divided up into sets?

Yeah, it seems to me they would play, uh... 20 on and 10 off, or 30 minutes at the most. Hmm. Maybe take 10 or 15 minutes, and when it was slow, they would take long... long breaks. Yeah. But, uh... on the weekends, they played, uh... steady. They... they worked hard. But they would take a lot of breaks. A lot of breaks. But short breaks. Thanks.
